# M3 (bytecode compiler + VM core) exit criterion: the language-semantics
# cases of HavokOS pike/tests/run_tests.pike's case table. Efun-library
# cases (sscanf, explode/implode edge cases, save/restore, crypt, ...) are
# M4 and object-model cases (destruct, environment, call_outs, ...) are M5;
# they're left out here, not failed.
#
